page.layout: One printed title page, single column, centred; an engraving in the middle with a small imprint below it.
page.l: Immanissimæque crudelitatis per Cliviam & VVestphaliam patratæ
Fidelissime conscripta & tabellis æneis repræsentata: Accedit
Ad insigne Pegasi. clɔ. Iɔ. c. xix.
page.notes: Engraving in the middle of the page: a woman seated with a man in plumed hat standing beside her, a burning town and execution scene behind, and a Hebrew tetragrammaton (יהוה) above. No running text. The imprint date reads clɔ. Iɔ. c. xix., i.e. MDCXIX. The ornamental "ꝛ" in "vander" is a printed ligature rendering. Some letters in the title are set in italic or swash forms (J, A, V) as printed.
